name: Autoblogging — AI Writer & Auto Internal Linking
author: Pete

sections.description:
Autoblogging.dev is two plugins in one — an AI writer that generates SEO articles automatically, and an auto internal linking engine that builds links across your entire site. Set it up once and your site grows on autopilot.

Whether you run a niche site, a blog, an eCommerce store, an agency, or any WordPress site that needs content — autoblogging is the fastest way to build topical authority and organic traffic without writing a single word yourself.

Why Autoblogging.dev?

Most AI writer plugins charge $100–$900 per month whether you publish or not. Autoblogging.dev charges per article only. No subscription, no contracts, credits never expire. Credits are charged per article only — no subscription, no contracts, credits never expire.

What Makes It Different

Every other autoblogging or AI writer plugin makes you buy a content tool and an internal linking tool separately. Autoblogging.dev does both in one plugin. Articles are generated with focus keywords that feed directly into the internal linking engine — automatically building a real internal link network across your entire site as your content grows.

What You Get Per Article

  • 1800–2200 words of humanized AI content that reads like a real person wrote it
  • H1 title, table of contents, 5+ H2 sections, FAQ section and conclusion
  • Focus keyword + 4 secondary keywords written automatically
  • Meta description written and saved to your SEO plugin automatically
  • Internal links injected across all posts the moment the article publishes
  • Published on your schedule or saved as draft for review first

Full Feature List

  • ✓ Humanized AI-generated 1800–2200 word articles
  • ✓ Auto image signature — add your logo once, appended at the end of every article with focus keyword alt text automatically on a 30x30px
  • ✓ Auto internal linking included — no separate plugin needed
  • ✓ All SEO meta written automatically
  • ✓ Credits never expire
  • ✓ Secure card checkout inside WordPress dashboard
  • ✓ Email support included
  • ✓ Rank Math and Yoast SEO compatible
  • ✓ AIOSEO and SEOPress compatible
  • ✓ Topic and keyword memory — 200 keywords tracked per site
  • ✓ No duplicate articles ever — remembers every topic covered
  • ✓ Charged only on successful generation — failed articles never deducted
  • ✓ No subscription ever — pay per article only
  • ✓ Auto category and subcategory detection with rotation queue
  • ✓ Timezone-aware scheduling — articles drip naturally through the day
  • ✓ Links report dashboard — see exactly which posts send and receive links
  • ✓ Rebuild index — works on existing articles too
  • ✓ Draft or publish mode — review before going live or fully automate
  • ✓ No API keys required — all API calls go through secure backend
  • ✓ Works with any WordPress theme or page builder
  • ✓ Compatible with LiteSpeed, WP Rocket and all major caching plugins

Auto Internal Linking Explained

The auto internal linker works independently of the AI writer. Every article’s focus keyword and secondary keywords are indexed site-wide when published. When any post is viewed, the plugin automatically injects links to matching posts at render time — nothing is written permanently to your database. Deactivate the plugin and all injected links disappear cleanly. Your articles stay, your data stays, nothing is held hostage.

You can also run the rebuild index on your existing articles. If you already have posts with focus keywords set in Rank Math or Yoast, the linker picks them up immediately and starts building your internal link network straight away — no new articles needed.

Who Is This For?

  • Niche site builders — build topical authority fast with consistent content on autopilot
  • Bloggers — keep your blog active without writing every post yourself
  • eCommerce stores — add a blog to your store and boost organic traffic automatically
  • Agencies — manage multiple client sites from one simple dashboard
  • Any WordPress site — if you want more organic traffic, you need more content and better internal linking

How It Works

  1. Install the plugin, then click “Connect” on the Getting Started page to request your API key
  2. Select your categories and publishing frequency
  3. Buy credits inside your WordPress dashboard via card payment
  4. Articles write themselves on schedule, SEO meta is saved, internal links build automatically
  5. Watch your organic traffic grow

Pricing

1 credit = 1 complete SEO article with auto internal linking included. Average cost from $0.20 USD per article. Credits never expire. No subscription ever. Buy a small trial pack to test before committing to larger packs. Failed generations are never charged.

External Services

This plugin connects to backend.autoblogging.dev to handle API key issuance/validation and AI article generation. This is a required service call, since all AI processing happens on our external servers, not locally, there is no local AI model or offline generation logic in this plugin.

What is sent and when:

  • On explicit user action only: clicking “Connect” on the Getting Started page sends your site URL and admin email to request an API key. Nothing is sent automatically on activation, no opt-out is needed because no data is sent without this explicit click.
  • On each article generation: selected category, used keywords, and used titles are sent to generate content.
  • On every plugin admin page, only once an API key is saved: the API key is sent to retrieve the current credit balance. Nothing is sent to check credits before an API key exists.
  • On API key validation: API key, timestamp, and HMAC signature are sent periodically to confirm the key is still valid.

No personally identifiable user data is collected beyond the site URL and admin email used for API key issuance, and both are only sent after the user explicitly clicks Connect.

Service provider: Autoblogging.dev
Terms of Service: https://autoblogging.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://autoblogging.dev/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/autoblogging-dev/ or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin, then go to Autoblogging.dev > Getting Started and click “Connect” to request your API key
  3. Go to Autoblogging.dev > Getting Started and follow the setup steps
  4. Install Rank Math or Yoast SEO for full SEO meta writing (recommended but not required)
  5. Add a server cron job for reliable scheduling — instructions provided inside the plugin
  6. Buy credits and turn on Auto Writer
sections.faq:
Do I need my own AI API key?

No. You use our API key through the plugin. Buy credits from us and we handle all API costs. You never need an Anthropic account or any API keys.

How does billing work?

A secure card checkout opens directly inside your WordPress dashboard when you click to buy credits. Credits are added automatically after payment is confirmed. You never leave your WordPress admin.

What happens if an article generation fails?

Credits are only deducted after a successful article is saved to your WordPress site. If generation fails for any reason, no credit is used and the category returns to the queue for the next scheduled run.

Do I need Rank Math or Yoast SEO?

Rank Math or Yoast SEO is recommended for full SEO meta writing. The plugin auto-detects which SEO plugin you have and writes focus keywords and meta descriptions to the correct fields. AIOSEO and SEOPress are also supported. The auto writer and auto linker work without an SEO plugin but you will not get automatic SEO meta written to new articles.

Can it link my existing articles?

Yes. Go to Auto Linker > Settings and click Rebuild Keyword Index. The plugin scans all your published posts, reads existing focus keywords from Rank Math or Yoast, and starts injecting internal links immediately. No new articles needed.

Will articles be flagged as AI content?

The prompt is engineered to produce human-sounding, conversational content that avoids common AI patterns and banned phrases. Google’s official position is that quality content is quality content regardless of how it was produced.

How does internal linking work technically?

Keywords are indexed site-wide when articles publish. Links are injected at render time using the_content filter — nothing is written permanently to your database. Deactivate the plugin and all injected links disappear cleanly. Your articles and data are always yours.

Can I review articles before they go live?

Yes. Set Initial Status to Draft in the Auto Writer settings and every generated article goes to your WordPress drafts folder for review. Switch to Publish Immediately when you are happy with the quality.

How many articles can I generate per day?

As many as you like. The plugin spreads generation evenly across all selected categories throughout the day based on your chosen frequency. Credits are the only limit.

Do credits expire?

Never. Buy when you need them and use them whenever you want.

Can I cancel?

There is no subscription to cancel. Credits never expire so nothing is lost. Contact admin@autoblogging.dev if you need help.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. The auto writer and auto linker use standard WordPress hooks and filters, making them fully compatible with any theme, page builder or caching plugin.

Does it add images to articles?

Add your logo or brand image once in the Getting Started setup and Autoblogging.dev automatically appends it to the bottom of every generated article with the focus keyword as the alt text. Additional images can be added manually to each article as normal in WordPress.
sections.changelog:
1.1.6

  • Removed the “Ad / Custom Code Slots” feature (free-text paste of ad/tracking network code). WordPress.org guidelines no longer permit plugins to accept arbitrary script/code paste from users. Paragraph spacing (a plain numeric setting, not code) is unaffected and remains available.

1.1.4

  • Replaced the raw echoed tag for paragraph spacing with wp_register_style()/wp_add_inline_style(), the standard WordPress pattern for dynamic CSS with no static file.

1.1.3

  • Removed the Google Fonts CDN call on admin pages; admin UI now uses system fonts only.
  • Ad slot codes are now sanitized against an explicit allowlist on save and again before output, instead of being stored/output unfiltered.

1.1.2

  • Renamed all function, option, hook, and asset names to a unique ablogai prefix.
  • Fixed credits check contacting the API before the user connects an API key.

1.1.1

  • Fixed internal linker only inserting one link, indexing no longer depends on the linker toggle being on
  • Fixed keyword index not staying in sync with manual edits, trashed, or deleted posts
  • Fixed plugin updates occasionally leaving the plugin deactivated
  • Fixed outbound links occasionally pointing to placeholder or commercial domains
  • Fixed rare stray “nn” text appearing between paragraphs
  • Fixed Links Report counts not matching what actually gets injected

1.0.0

  • Initial release — AI writer, auto internal linking, Rank Math and Yoast integration, card payment credits system
